guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 服務水頭、漏失敏感度與調壓動態驗證。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Service head, leakage sensitivity and pressure-control dynamics. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設壓力水頭由40 m降至30 m、漏失指數N=1.2，Q2/Q1=(30/40)^1.2=0.7081；假設原漏失10 L/s，則為7.081 L/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓差Δp=200 kPa、Q=0.020 m³/s，耗散水力功率P=ΔpQ=4000 W=4.0 kW，不是發電量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓降hv=20 m、其餘受控支路損失hr=30 m，權度Av=hv/(hv+hr)=0.40，為指定工況比較。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設壓力水頭變化率dh/dt=−0.020 m/s、總延遲τ=180 s，未觀測變化Δh≈τdh/dt=−3.60 m。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m. Pressure head h=H−z−hf=25 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m. Delivered q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume head falls from 40 m to 30 m and leakage exponent N=1.2. Q2/Q1=(30/40)^1.2=0.7081; assumed initial leakage 10 L/s becomes 7.081 L/s.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve drop Δp=200 kPa and Q=0.020 m³/s. Dissipated hydraulic power P=ΔpQ=4000 W=4.0 kW, not generated power.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve loss hv=20 m and remaining controlled-branch loss hr=30 m. Authority Av=hv/(hv+hr)=0.40 for the specified operating condition.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume head-change rate dh/dt=−0.020 m/s and total delay τ=180 s. Unobserved change Δh≈τdh/dt=−3.60 m.
timeline: 2010　美國環保署水損控制指南發布，討論多種減損方法。
2020　EPANET第二點二版手冊說明壓力相依需求與管網分析。
2021　新加坡公布智慧水表首期方案，提供需求資料比較背景。
timelineEn: 2010 — EPA publishes water-loss guidance describing multiple reduction approaches.
2020 — The EPANET 2.2 manual documents pressure-dependent demand and network analysis.
2021 — Singapore announces first-phase smart metering, providing demand-data comparison context.

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：配水管網壓力管理
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Pressure management of water-distribution networks
guides.concept: 本課從高程與服務壓力出發，分析壓力相依需求、漏失指數及閥門耗能，再進入閥權度、遠端延遲、回授方向和備援供水。最後把快速水錘與低流量水質納入同一管理問題，讓節水效益與服務可靠度各有證據，不把降低平均壓力當成唯一成功指標。
guides.conceptEn: Beginning with elevation and service pressure, this course examines pressure-dependent demand, leakage exponents and valve dissipation, then addresses authority, remote delay, feedback direction and backup supply. Rapid transients and low-flow water quality complete the management problem, giving savings and service reliability separate evidence instead of treating lower average pressure as the only success metric.
procedure: 壓力管理要控制的是用戶與關鍵設施可取得的壓力，不能只追求減壓閥出口的一個數字。節點水頭包含高程與壓力，沿途摩阻又隨需求變動，因此低處壓力過高時，高處仍可能接近供水不足；管理分區需同時考慮高程帶、管路阻力與代表性服務點。下式分開能量水頭、高程及流動損失，忽略速度水頭差；所得壓力水頭只適用指定需求工況，不代表全天最小值。
傳統固定需求模型可能在壓力不足時仍要求節點供出全部流量，造成不合理的負壓結果。壓力相依需求把可供流量連到可用壓力區間，使缺水成為可量化輸出；但需求曲線仍是模型假設，不能將所有用戶、儲水設備與消防用途視為相同的孔口行為。此例採分段模型：低於最低水頭供量為零，達要求水頭供滿量，中間以平方根插值；參數不是任何地方服務標準。
降低壓力通常能降低既有漏口流量，但效果取決於漏口是否隨壓力張開、材料拘束及不同漏點的組合。固定孔口平方根關係不一定代表整區漏失，經驗指數也不是材料常數；若合法用水、閥位或漏點數同時改變，觀測到的曲線便不能單獨歸因於壓力。本式比較相同漏口群、代表壓力定義不變的兩個狀態，不預測新破口發生率；指數須在適用範圍內校準。
減壓閥藉節流將一部分水力能轉成湍流、熱及振動，閥後壓力降低不代表能量被回收。壓差與通量共同決定耗散功率，而局部高速區可能涉及空化與噪音；設計需對照閥型、上下游絕對壓力及運轉範圍，不能只從平均壓差選擇設備。壓差乘流量是流體功率差，未乘任何發電效率；只有另設能量回收裝置並證實效率時，才能估可利用電力。
控制閥的作用取決於自身壓降相對整個受控支路壓降的比例，閥位改變不一定帶來同樣比例的流量變化。閥過大時可能長期在很小開度工作，機械間隙與摩擦會放大調節困難；閥權度提供一種局部比較，但不能單獨描述導閥、控制器與管網的動態穩定性。此比值在同一工況下分開閥門與其餘支路損失，沒有給出通用合格門檻；實際控制增益還取決於閥特性與邊界。
以遠端服務點回授可改善代表性，但通訊延遲使控制器看到的是過去狀態而非當前壓力。需求快速增加時，延遲期間的壓降可能已消耗原有裕度；資料時間戳、封包重送與感測器濾波都會增加有效滯後，不能只把無線傳輸的名目速度當整體延遲。線性變化率乘延遲只估未觀測的水頭改變，並非實際控制響應；需求突變與非線性管網仍需另外模擬。
壓力回授必須先確認誤差符號與閥門作用方向，否則負回授可能被接成正回授。比例增益把壓力誤差轉成控制量，但實際壓力還受閥特性、管網儲能及延遲影響；提高增益未必改善速度，積分飽和與機械死區可能讓系統反而反覆超越目標。本式只是指定符號的控制量算術，不是可直接投入現場的增益；正百分點方向必須由設備作用定義，不假設等於開閥。
壓力管理設備檢修或失效時，替代供水路徑的水頭損失可能不同於正常路徑。備援管路存在不代表備援服務能力足夠，較小管徑、較長距離或不同水源高程都會降低遠端壓力；評估需按實際可用的水源與閥位重建網路，而不是把名目容量直接相加。此例只檢查一個指定備援工況的水頭餘量，不包含水源可用性、消防需求與瞬變；負餘量表示假設條件未滿足比較需求。
降低長期平均壓力不代表每一次調節都降低瞬間峰值，過快閥動作會改變流速並激發壓力波。控制器時間尺度與管線波傳時間可能相差很大，延時管網模型無法解析快速水錘；因此壓力管理方案需把服務水頭、控制動態及瞬變包絡分開而又一致地驗證。焦可夫斯基算例只估單一快速波前的壓力增量，不是閥動作建議，也不包含反射、低壓空穴及其他設備邊界。
壓力管理改變漏流與部分壓力相依需求後，某些支線的更新水量可能下降，水齡和消毒劑衰減便需要重新評估。幾何容積除以通量只給理想平均停留尺度，實際管網有混合、短路及死端分布；不能以較少水量損失直接推定所有水質指標都會改善。本例假設固定容積與穩定通量，只計平均尺度；它不是所有水粒子的年齡，也沒有提供任何水質合格判準。
procedureEn: Pressure management concerns pressure available to customers and critical facilities, not merely one number at a reducing-valve outlet. Nodal head includes elevation and pressure, while friction changes with demand. A low-lying area can have excessive pressure while an elevated area approaches insufficient supply, so zoning must consider elevation bands, resistance and representative service points together. The relation separates energy head, elevation and losses while neglecting velocity-head differences. The resulting pressure head applies to one demand condition, not the daily minimum.

A fixed-demand model can require full delivery even when pressure is insufficient, producing unrealistic negative pressures. Pressure-dependent demand relates available flow to a pressure range and makes supply deficit an explicit output. The demand curve remains an assumption, however, and customers, storage installations and fire-service functions cannot all be treated as identical orifices. The example sets zero delivery below minimum head, full delivery at required head and square-root interpolation between them. Its parameters are not jurisdictional service standards.

Reducing pressure generally reduces flow through existing leaks, but the effect depends on opening deformation, restraint and the mix of leaks. A fixed-orifice square-root relation need not represent district leakage, and an empirical exponent is not a material constant. Simultaneous changes in authorized use, valve state or leak count prevent attributing an observed curve to pressure alone. The relation compares the same leak population under a consistent representative-pressure definition. It does not predict new-break frequency, and its exponent requires calibration within the applicable range.

A pressure-reducing valve converts hydraulic energy into turbulence, heat and vibration through throttling; lower downstream pressure does not mean energy recovery. Pressure difference and flow determine dissipated power, while local high-speed zones may involve cavitation and noise. Equipment assessment needs valve type, absolute boundary pressures and operating range rather than average pressure drop alone. Pressure difference times flow is a fluid-power difference with no generation efficiency applied. Useful electric power requires a separate recovery device and substantiated efficiency.

A control valve’s influence depends on its pressure drop relative to the controlled branch, so a position change does not necessarily produce a proportional flow change. An oversized valve may operate near closure where backlash and friction complicate regulation. Valve authority offers a local comparison but cannot by itself describe pilot, controller and network dynamic stability. The ratio separates valve loss from the rest of the branch at one condition and supplies no universal acceptance threshold. Actual control gain also depends on valve characteristic and boundaries.

Remote service-point feedback can improve representation, but communication delay means the controller sees a past state rather than current pressure. During rising demand, pressure can consume its available margin before the update arrives. Timestamps, retransmission and sensor filtering all add effective lag, so nominal wireless transmission speed does not equal total feedback delay. A linear rate times delay estimates unobserved head change, not actual closed-loop response. Demand steps and nonlinear network behavior still require separate modeling.

Pressure feedback first needs consistent error sign and valve action, or intended negative feedback becomes positive feedback. Proportional gain converts pressure error into a command, while actual pressure also depends on valve characteristics, network storage and delay. Higher gain need not improve response; integral saturation and mechanical deadband can instead create repeated overshoot. This is command arithmetic under a declared sign convention, not a field-ready gain. The positive percentage-point direction must be defined by equipment action and is not presumed to mean opening.

During maintenance or failure of pressure-management equipment, an alternative supply path can have different head losses from the normal route. A bypass does not guarantee adequate backup service: smaller diameter, longer length or another source elevation can reduce remote pressure. Assessment must reconstruct actual available sources and valve states instead of simply adding nominal capacities. The example checks head margin for one backup condition, excluding source availability, fire demand and transients. A negative margin means the assumed case does not meet the comparison requirement.

Lower long-term mean pressure does not guarantee lower instantaneous peaks during every adjustment. Rapid valve motion changes velocity and launches pressure waves. Controller and wave-travel time scales can differ greatly, and an extended-period network model cannot resolve fast water hammer. Service head, control dynamics and transient envelopes therefore need separate but consistent verification. The Joukowsky example estimates one rapid wavefront’s increment only. It is not a valve-action recommendation and excludes reflections, low-pressure cavities and other equipment boundaries.

After pressure management changes leakage and some pressure-dependent demand, renewal flow in certain branches can decrease, requiring reassessment of water age and disinfectant decay. Volume divided by flow gives an ideal mean residence scale, while actual networks contain mixing, short circuits and dead ends. Reduced physical loss therefore does not directly establish improvement in every water-quality indicator. The example assumes fixed volume and steady throughput to calculate a mean scale only. It is not the age of every water parcel and supplies no water-quality acceptance criterion.
evidence: 繪出高低兩個服務點在相同閥後水頭下的壓力差，加入需求增加造成的摩阻。列出應監測的最不利位置，避免只以平均區壓決定管理策略。
以三個水頭值跨越最低與要求界線，檢查分段需求是否連續且不超過滿額需求。再說明哪些用戶資料可支持參數，而哪些仍應保留敏感度範圍。
用固定孔口指數與另一個假設經驗指數比較同一壓力變化，列出結果差異。把減少既有漏流與降低新破管風險分成兩個需不同證據的問題。
將同一壓差下兩個流量的耗散功率比較，另畫出有能量回收裝置時的效率鏈。明確區分功率與一段時間的能量，再列出設備適用性仍需的資料。
在相同邊界下比較兩種假設閥特性，標出日常工況落在哪個開度區間。使用權度解釋局部敏感性，同時列出它無法判斷的動態與機械問題。
evidenceEn: Draw pressures at high and low service points under one valve-outlet head and add demand-dependent friction. Identify limiting monitoring locations instead of selecting management strategy from average district pressure alone.

Evaluate three heads spanning minimum and required limits, checking continuity and the full-demand cap. Explain which customer observations support the parameters and which uncertainties should remain as sensitivity ranges.

Compare one pressure change using a fixed-orifice exponent and another hypothetical fitted exponent. Separate reduction of existing leakage from prevention of new breaks, identifying the different evidence needed for each.

Compare dissipated power at two flows under one pressure drop and draw a separate efficiency chain for a recovery device. Distinguish power from time-integrated energy and list remaining equipment-suitability data.

Compare two hypothetical valve characteristics under identical boundaries, marking their normal operating openings. Use authority to explain local sensitivity while listing dynamic and mechanical issues it cannot resolve.
pitfalls: 只在減壓閥附近量到足夠壓力，可能漏掉遠端或高處缺壓；若把地面高程錯當管線量測基準，模型又會把壓力不足誤判成儀器偏差。
若把修復後漏點減少的效果算進壓力指數，會高估下一次減壓效益；相反，合法夜用水增加也可能掩蓋真實漏失下降，讓管理措施被誤判無效。
只按最大流量選擇很大閥徑，可能讓日常操作落在難以控制的小開度；反覆小幅動作會增加磨耗與壓力波動，即使最大供量仍能達到。
符號設定錯誤會讓低壓時的動作進一步降低壓力，形成正回授；增益過高還可能使閥位頻繁反轉，增加磨耗並把控制波動傳到用戶端。
只看每十五分鐘平均壓力可能完全漏掉秒級壓峰，讓減壓措施被誤判為同時解決所有水錘；快速回授反覆動作也可能增加管殼循環應力。
pitfallsEn: Adequate pressure near a reducing valve can conceal shortages at remote or elevated users. Confusing ground elevation with the pressure-measurement datum can then misclassify a genuine pressure deficit as instrument error.

Including leak removal from repairs in a pressure exponent overstates the benefit of a later pressure reduction. Conversely, increased legitimate night use can hide real leakage reduction and make the measure appear ineffective.

Sizing a valve only for maximum flow can place ordinary operation in a poorly controllable near-closed range. Repeated small movements increase wear and pressure fluctuation even when maximum delivery remains adequate.

An incorrect sign can make the response to low pressure reduce pressure further, creating positive feedback. Excessive gain can also reverse valve motion repeatedly, increasing wear and transmitting control oscillations to customers.

Fifteen-minute mean pressure can completely miss second-scale peaks and falsely suggest that pressure reduction solved every transient. Repeated rapid feedback actions can also increase cyclic shell stress.

related.title: 長距離輸水管水錘分析
related.titleEn: Water-hammer analysis for long water mains
related.transfer: 可遷移「高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證」與「回授增益與控制方向機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；長距離輸水管水錘分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification" and "Feedback gain and control direction mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Water-hammer analysis for long water mains must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦服務水頭、漏失敏感度與調壓動態驗證；長距離輸水管水錘分析則以波傳播、邊界反射與輸水瞬變驗證為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on service head, leakage sensitivity and pressure-control dynamics; Water-hammer analysis for long water mains centres on wave propagation, boundary reflections and water-main transient verification, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「高程水頭與服務壓力」與「穩態水頭基線」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到長距離輸水管水錘分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Elevation head and service pressure” and “Steady hydraulic baseline”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Water-hammer analysis for long water mains, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 配水管網壓力管理
history.text: 壓力管理由單一閥門調節擴展成分區觀測與服務可靠度問題。美國環保署2010年水損指南討論多種控制措施，2020年EPANET手冊加入壓力相依需求能力，讓模型可區分要求流量與可供流量。香港智管網把壓力管理區與分區計量連結，新加坡2021年智慧水表公告則提供需求數位化的比較背景。這些公開資料支持方法脈絡，並不提供本課假設閥門增益、壓力需求或水質門檻；列名計畫也不被宣稱採用每一個教學算式。
history.textEn: Pressure management has expanded from individual valve regulation into district observation and service reliability. EPA’s 2010 water-loss guide discusses multiple control measures, while the 2020 EPANET manual adds pressure-dependent demand capability, distinguishing requested from available delivery. Hong Kong’s Water Intelligent Network links pressure-management areas with district metering, and Singapore’s 2021 smart-meter announcement offers a demand-digitalization comparison. These sources establish method context rather than the lesson’s hypothetical gains, required pressures or water-quality limits, and named programmes are not presumed to use every teaching equation.
